entries.name: ZnO wurtzite bulk reference
entries.description: ZnO wurtzite bulk reference; external reference, not measured atomic coordinates of the synthesis sample.
entries.scope: Independent undoped bulk ZnO comparison (Kihara and Donnay1985,COD9004178), not a measured nanocrystal or dopant arrangement. Fu2007 reports wurtzite; Schwartz2003 reports a wurtzite ZnO host. This reference has a=3.2494Å,c=5.2038Å, distinct from the cited bulk parameters a=3.2495Å,c=5.2067Å in Schwartz2003. Co/Ni occupancy, particle surfaces and exact sample geometry are not assigned.

entries.name: FCC iridium bulk reference
entries.description: FCC iridium bulk reference; external reference, not measured atomic coordinates of the synthesis sample.
entries.scope: Bulk FCC Ir reference for comparison only. Stowell2005 reports FCC for its OA/oleylamine specimens. Shah2001 reports crystalline Ir by microscopy without a refined phase assignment or atomic coordinates; this reference does not establish the phase or structure of that specimen.
entries.sample_context_note: The listed oa-xrd and oa-fig1d contexts belong only to Stowell2005. Shah2001 has no measured-coordinate or phase-refinement link.

entries.name: Zinc-blende InP bulk reference
entries.description: Zinc-blende InP bulk reference; external reference, not measured atomic coordinates of the synthesis sample.
entries.scope: Tessier2015 zinc-blende evidence belongs to the separately discussed 20 min reference-condition sample; exact identity with the 30 min Reference 1 protocol product is unresolved. This external reference does not fill that gap.

entries.name: Orthorhombic CsPbBr3 bulk reference
entries.description: Orthorhombic CsPbBr3 bulk reference; external reference, not measured atomic coordinates of the synthesis sample.
entries.scope: Zhang2019 main p.9142 reports orthorhombic perovskite; TDPA-specific XRD is SI Figure S2f. The paper cites ICSD98751. This independent COD4510745 reference is not that ICSD entry or the TDPA specimen.

entries.name: Rocksalt CoO bulk reference
entries.description: Rocksalt CoO bulk reference; external reference, not measured atomic coordinates of the synthesis sample.
entries.scope: Saha2019 main pp.2423–2424 reports cubic CoO core. This external reference has a=4.263 angstrom, different from paper values 4.258 and 4.246 angstrom; no lattice was silently refit to the paper.

entries.name: Partially inverse CoFe2O4 bulk reference
entries.description: Partially inverse CoFe2O4 bulk reference; external reference, not measured atomic coordinates of the synthesis sample.
entries.scope: Saha2019 reports an inverse-spinel CoFe2O4 shell, without atomic-coordinate refinement or site occupancies. COD1533163 is an external partially inverse reference, with its own mixed-site occupancies and a=8.3806 angstrom rather than the paper shell value 8.373 angstrom.
entries.component_role: CoFe2O4 shell reference only; partially inverse occupancy is external

entries.name: Ideal diamond-Si bulk comparison reference
entries.description: Ideal diamond-Si reference at the paper's quoted bulk a0 = 5.43 angstrom. Constructed geometry, not an experimental sample structure.
entries.scope: The 6.0 and 2.0 formulations have diamond-Si evidence. This ideal reference uses the paper's quoted bulk comparison value, not experimentally refined sample coordinates. The separate 3 nm sphere is an arbitrary illustration.
entries.sourceLinkLabel: Paper supplying the bulk comparison parameter
entries.finiteCaption: Illustrative spherical crop with a chosen 3 nm envelope. Size and shape are visualization choices, not a measured Littau specimen or a fitted sample model.
entries.sourceLocator: Main PDF p. 5, printed p. 1228, Results A, lattice-parameter comparison; main p. 4 Figure 6 caption.
entries.component_role: Ideal crystalline silicon reference only; no oxide-shell model.

entries.name: Bulk wurtzite CdSe reference · core comparison
entries.description: Independent COD9016056 bulk CdSe comparison. Not a measured nanocrystal, shell, interface or film structure.
entries.scope: A pure bulk wurtzite CdSe reference for core comparison. Danek Figure3 and Dabbousi Figure13 include wurtzite comparisons; this model does not reconstruct either experimental overlayer or interface. No ZnS, CdS or ZnSe shell atoms are added.

entries.name: Ideal rock-salt PbSe reference
entries.description: Constructed ideal rock-salt prototype using the paper rounded lattice parameter 6.1 Å; not measured or refined sample coordinates.
entries.scope: Constructed ideal reference using reported rounded a = 6.1 Å. Source SAED/HRTEM supports rock-salt order; no sample coordinates or measured assembly atom model are supplied. P1 export expands all eight conventional-cell sites; ideal prototype Fm-3m.
entries.finiteCaption: Illustrative 8 × 8 × 8 cell PbSe block: 4.88 nm cell envelope; 4.575 nm atom-center span. Chosen visualization dimensions, not a fitted or measured particle. No surface ligands or assembly geometry reconstructed.

entries.name: Undoped bulk ZnO · external host reference
entries.description: Independent bulk wurtzite ZnO comparison. No measured Norberg atomic coordinates.
entries.scope: Undoped Kihara–Donnay 1985 reference only, a=3.2494 Å and c=5.2038 Å. Neither the paper dopant fraction nor ligand surface geometry is represented. D–F outcomes and model-spin coordinates are not supplied by this reference.
entries.finiteCaption: Illustrative finite 4 × 4 × 3 cell crop of independent undoped bulk ZnO COD9004178. Chosen block geometry, not a Norberg nanocrystal or film. No Mn atoms, inferred vacancies, surface ligands or passivation are added. Zn–O links use a stated 1.7–2.2 Å visualization window, not a measured bond refinement.

excluded_materials.reason: Source phase and stoichiometry unresolved; no phase assigned.

scope: Independent database references and explicitly constructed ideal prototypes for comparison; never measured sample atomic coordinates or training labels.
